name: dynamic_parent
note: Existing /1 expresses unresolved dynamic page title as null; no child fallback.

name: two_page_titles
note: Ambiguous page title policy must fail closed pending a reviewed SwiftUI precedence decision.

name: label_title_ambiguous
note: A title in a label closure has unresolved preference propagation; do not claim it belongs to a destination.

name: toolbar_title_ambiguous
note: Toolbar title ownership requires runtime evidence; fail rather than guess.

name: unsupported_fullscreen
note: Unknown presentation boundaries must not be assumed equivalent to sheet.

name: conditional_title_ambiguous
note: Raw-source profile cannot decide active #if branch; GAP-19 remains open.

name: removed_destination_wrapper
note: Negative mutation: removing NavigationLink removes evidence the child title is separate.

name: unclosed_destination
note: Malformed source must fail visibly instead of selecting a partial title.

name: unclosed_raw_string
note: Unclosed raw string must fail visibly.

name: bare_regex_ambiguous
note: Bare regex is valid with -enable-bare-slash-regex; without the resolved profile its slash ownership must not be guessed.

name: ordinary_division
note: A spaced arithmetic division must not be mistaken for a regex literal.

name: bare_regex_after_operator
note: Bare regex after an operator is valid with -enable-bare-slash-regex; unknown build profile must not yield a guessed title.

name: nonview_receiver
note: Unknown non-View receiver in local binding; do not assert a page title.

name: unused_local_view
note: A View-valued local binding alone does not prove it reaches the returned page.

name: nonview_argument
note: A method call used as a Text argument is not a proved View modifier.

name: bare_regex_after_where
note: Valid with -enable-bare-slash-regex; unresolved build profile must fail rather than treating regex content as a title.

name: helper_unused
note: Referencing a View helper in an unused binding does not establish it reaches the page output.

name: helper_description
note: Passing a View helper to a non-View description is not mounting the helper as page content.

name: helper_dropped
note: Discarding a View helper in a local binding does not establish page output.

name: helper_returned

title.anchor: private var content: some View { Text("Root").navigationTitle("Parent") }

note: A directly returned view helper contributes its title.

name: navigation_shadow
note: A locally shadowing NavigationLink can render its closure as page content; name matching cannot prove SwiftUI destination ownership.

name: modifier_shadow
note: A custom same-named Text extension can override the SwiftUI navigationTitle modifier; receiver type alone is insufficient.

name: group_conditional
note: A title in a conditional child has no proved returned-page ownership.

name: chained_unused
note: A multiline modifier on an unused local does not reach page output.

name: multiple_root_views
note: Multiple root views do not establish which child title reaches page output.

name: sheet_shadow
note: A locally shadowed sheet method does not prove a SwiftUI presentation boundary.
